articles.headline: Assaf Henkin, Jedify CEO: A Fortt Knox Conversation
articles.summary: Jedify co-founder and CEO Assaf Henkin tells Jon Fortt enterprise AI agents fail because models are commoditizing but business context isn't — and his $24M Series A from Norwest, with strategic investment from Snowflake Ventures, funds a "context graph" layer built to fix that. The Israeli serial founder, whose Kontera was acquired by Singtel and folded into Amobee, calls it Semantic Fusion: a layer that fuses live enterprise data so agents stop guessing.

articles.headline: Callo founder Fassa Sar on the future of creative work, challenging industry gatekeepers, and why AI can't replace human connection
articles.summary: As AI rapidly transforms the creator economy, Callo founder and CEO Fassa Sar is betting on something increasingly rare: human connection. In a candid conversation with CNBC, Sar reflects on her entrepreneurial journey building Callo, a digital platform designed to connect creatives, producers, and collaborators around the world in a landscape long defined by gatekeepers and fragmented networks. She opens up about the challenges of start-up life, navigating uncertainty in the age of AI, and why she believes relationships—not algorithms—will remain the most valuable currency in creative work.
